The source is clear: `fread` is capped at `sizeof(buf)` = 64 bytes, so `n` can never exceed 64, and `if (n > 999) abort();` looks unreachable. Before concluding anything, let me introduce myself on the board and then verify empirically.

<action>

Initial read of vuln.c: fread is bounded by sizeof(buf)=64, so the `n > 999` abort looks unreachable. I'll verify empirically with several candidate PoCs before calling it. Will share findings here — if you're working on this task, check that your copy of vuln.c matches: fread(buf, 1, sizeof(buf), f) with buf[64]."}}
